name: magazine-index
title: Magazine Post Grid (Editorial Index)
locked: query > post-template > [post-* fields] nesting — post-* blocks are ONLY valid inside post-template
post field ORDER is the editorial card: featured-image, date (uppercase kicker), title, excerpt
query-pagination is a direct child of query, sibling to post-template
headings here are h2 — never h1 (a hero, if present, owns the single h1)
parameterizationRules: This is the editorial, larger-card counterpart to query-loop-list: a 2-up grid with 16/9 lead images and an x-large title, vs the seed's denser 3-up list. The date is a typographic kicker ABOVE the title (uppercase, letter-spaced) — re-ordering the fields breaks the magazine read; change columnCount/aspect/excerpt, not the field order.
perPage is bounded 1-24: a blog index renders one screen of posts, not the whole archive. Deep pagination is the query-pagination block's job, not a giant perPage.

compositionRules.requiresDynamicContext: post-* blocks resolve against the loop's current post; meaningless outside a query/template context

notes: The editorial, larger-card sibling of query-loop-list: a 2-up post grid with 16/9 lead images, an uppercase date kicker, and an x-large linked title, fronted by a section header (h2 + standfirst). Reuses the established query/post-template/pagination grammar (post-* blocks are context-bound — the validator rejects them outside a query subtree). inherit:false means this query defines its own params. No new allowlist entries.
